name: Python Interview Questions
title: Python Interview Questions
description: Practice these 118 Python Interview Questions and prepare for freshers interviews. Use the detailed explanations for MCQs whose answer you don't know.

modules.name: Basic Python syntax and data types
modules.description: Fundamental building blocks of Python programming. Covers core concepts like variables, data types, and basic operations.

submodules.name: Basic Python syntax and data types

modules.name: Control flow
modules.description: Mechanisms for directing the flow of program execution. Includes conditional statements and different types of loops.

modules.name: String manipulation
modules.description: Techniques for working with and modifying text data. Covers string methods, formatting, and basic pattern matching.

modules.name: Lists, tuples, and dictionaries
modules.description: Key data structures for storing collections of items. Explores the properties and methods of these versatile data types.

modules.name: Functions and lambda expressions
modules.description: Tools for code organization and reusability. Covers defining and using functions, including compact lambda expressions.

modules.name: File I/O operations
modules.description: Methods for reading from and writing to files. Includes working with different file formats and using context managers.

modules.name: Modules and packages
modules.description: Techniques for organizing and reusing code across files. Covers importing, creating modules, and understanding package structure.

modules.name: Exception handling
modules.description: Mechanisms for handling and managing errors in code. Includes try-except blocks and creating custom exceptions.

modules.name: Python standard library
modules.description: Overview of built-in modules for common tasks. Includes working with dates, random numbers, and mathematical operations.

modules.name: Object-oriented programming concepts
modules.description: Paradigm for structuring code around objects and classes. Covers core OOP principles and their implementation in Python.

modules.name: Virtual environments
modules.description: Tools for isolating project dependencies. Covers creating and managing separate environments for different projects.

modules.name: Basic understanding of PEP 8
modules.description: Guidelines for writing consistent, readable Python code. Covers key style recommendations from the official style guide.
